subject: REPOSITORY paragraph
notes: kb/Work PB1086: Rule (cite.py --check 12.3.8.3 'there shall be information in the external repository for the class object-class-name-1' -> OK §12.3.8.3 6)): without EXPANDS, a) literal-1 / b) object-class-name-1 shall have external-repository information. Code: the class-specifier is only screened for SR1/SR2 (BindSpecifierExternalizedName); the only information source is the compilation group's OoClassTable, consulted at REFERENCE sites (OoNameResolution.Resolve -> COBOL0813/0859 'no such class is defined in this compilation group'). Probe out/probe/repo/sr10.cob (--std 2023): 'CLASS NOSUCHCL' naming no class anywhere -> compiles clean and runs; sr6.cob adds 'USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE NOSUCHCL' -> COBOL0813 only then. Expected: the specifier itself violates SR6 (no information exists - there is no external repository, §8.13). Under-rejects for an unreferenced specifier; and a class that DOES exist outside the group can never be declared usefully (no external repository).
